title: AnyPoC: Universal Proof-of-Concept Test Generation for Scalable LLM-Based Bug Detection
datasets: 12 large OSS systems for campaign (~2,700 candidate reports); 192-report validation corpus (96 true/96 false, LLM/human) not found in public repo.
models: Paper: Claude Code/Opus 4.5-4.6 and Codex/GPT-5.2-5.3-Codex; current CLI model depends on local agent
license: Apache-2.0 current author repo; paper CC BY 4.0
input_setting: Bug report + source/build env; analyzer extracts trigger/root cause/consequence; generator and independent checker produce/verify executable PoC
reproduction_grade: B (conditional: author implementation public but no frozen paper evaluation corpus/version/results)
limitation: Current author repo is evolving product, not confirmed paper snapshot; 192-report test set and raw outputs absent. Large system builds and paid/local agent CLI. No standard Defects4J/BugsInPy/SWT evaluation.
task: PoC generation and independent validation of arbitrary bug reports; false-report rejection
